# Parichay

Parichay is a client-side personal manual builder. 

Most software saves your data to a database. Parichay does not. It runs entirely in your browser. There are no accounts, no analytics tracking, and no servers storing your answers.

Users build "Me Manuals" or "Work Manuals" to document their working styles, boundaries, and unspoken context. You control exactly what leaves the page: answers can be marked as Included, Private, or Omitted. 

## Core Details

- Product: Privacy-first personal manual studio
- Tagline: Your Story, Always Ready.
- Storage: Client-side only (localStorage and URL state)
- Accounts: None
- Database: None
- Analytics: None
- Pricing: Free

## Visibility Rules

- **Included**: These answers appear in share links, QR codes, image exports, and PDFs.
- **Private**: These answers stay on your device. They only leave the page if you generate a private local export or print it yourself. They are never sent in a shared URL.
- **Omitted**: These answers are completely ignored in previews, shares, and exports.

- How it works: https://parichay-your-story.vercel.app/how-it-works
